name: Laposta
description: Automate subscriber management, sync contacts, and trigger workflows with Laposta ,  the Dutch email marketing platform.

events.d: Create a mailing list with name, remarks, subscribe/unsubscribe notification emails, and optional lock.
Add or update a subscriber in a chosen list using email, name, and custom fields.
Retrieve subscribers from a selected list; filter by state and select response fields like list_id or timezone.
Create a Laposta email campaign with subject, sender (name & email), recipient lists, optional reply-to, and tracking settings.
Runs when a subscriber is unsubscribed from a chosen list.
Permanently delete a mailing list by selecting its list ID.
Retrieve a mailing list by its List ID.
Delete all active subscribers from a selected list by list ID.
Retrieve a campaign by its ID. Choose a campaign_id to fetch its details.
Retrieve all campaigns and optionally return only chosen response fields.
Delete a selected campaign by ID.
Retrieve all mailing lists and optionally return only selected fields.
